verdict.rationale: Vapi's phone quickstart shows a programmatic client call (`const assistant = await vapi.assistant`), which implies an official server-side SDK. The web quickstart describes building real-time voice interfaces for web and mobile, which suggests client SDKs, and the docs host an `/sdk/` section. However, no item names specific SDK packages, supported languages, install steps or reference docs. missing for 10: explicit list of official SDK languages/packages, install and API-reference documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
